stories.title: Tool Schema and Validation Contract
stories.description: Define Pydantic schemas for all allowlisted tools including input structure, required fields, and validation rules. Establish a consistent contract for tool invocation and error handling on validation failure.

stories.title: Allowlist-Based Tool Routing Logic
stories.description: Implement core routing logic that dispatches tool calls based on an explicit allowlist. Ensure only approved tools can be executed and enforce rejection of unknown or unauthorized tool names.

stories.title: Chat History Injection into Tool Context
stories.description: Implement logic to inject relevant chat history into tool execution context, ensuring tools receive necessary conversational state without violating token or privacy constraints.

stories.title: Tool Router API Integration with Main Loop
stories.description: Integrate tool routing and validation into the FastAPI main application loop, handling Anthropic tool_use blocks and ensuring seamless execution within the agentic workflow.

stories.title: Tool Routing and Validation Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering allowlist enforcement, schema validation failures, correct tool dispatch, and chat history injection behavior.
